# Jay Lakum — Freelance Shopify & WooCommerce Performance Developer

> Independent senior e-commerce developer specializing in mobile page speed optimization, Core Web Vitals, and checkout debugging for webshops in the Netherlands and Europe.

## Overview
- **Name:** Jay Lakum
- **Role:** Freelance Shopify & WooCommerce Specialist
- **Website:** https://jaylakum.com/
- **Dutch Portal:** https://jaylakum.com/nl/
- **Target Market:** Netherlands (Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Utrecht, Den Haag, Eindhoven) and Europe
- **Work Model:** Direct developer collaboration, async-first (Loom/WhatsApp/Email), 100% Pay on Delivery after staging verification, no hourly billing surprises.

## Core Specializations
1. **Mobile Speed & Core Web Vitals Sprint:**
   - Reducing Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) to under 2.5 seconds on real mobile 4G/5G connections.
   - Eliminating Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) and optimizing Interaction to Next Paint (INP).
   - Stripping orphan/leftover Shopify Liquid scripts and unused JavaScript plugins.
   - Next-gen WebP/AVIF image compression and responsive srcset implementation.

2. **Checkout & Payment Troubleshooting (iDEAL / Mollie):**
   - Resolving Mollie and iDEAL webhook failures, drop-offs, and stuck order statuses.
   - Fixing slow WooCommerce cart and AJAX checkout hangs.
   - Diagnosing carrier and ERP plugin latency (PostNL, DHL, Exact Online).

3. **Boutique Webshop Redesign & High-Performance Architecture:**
   - Bespoke Shopify Online Store 2.0 and WooCommerce block theme development.
   - Clean, lightweight code without bloated page builders.

## Verified Client Case Studies
- **Nordic Apparel & Accessories (Fashion Boutique):** Reduced mobile LCP from 6.1s to 2.2s (-64% load time reduction), passed Google Core Web Vitals, and eliminated leftover ghost app scripts. URL: https://jaylakum.com/case-study/
- **Gecko Monaco:** Shopify luxury leather goods storefront performance.
- **Opulentt:** High-converting boutique fragrance webshop.
